component.name: Motif
component.summary: Browse, download, apply, and manage GTK and GNOME themes

description.p: Motif is a native GTK4 and Libadwaita desktop application for GNOME that brings a smooth, one-click experience to browsing, downloading, applying, and managing desktop themes.

ul.li: Browse GTK, GNOME Shell, Icon, and Cursor themes from gnome-look.org (OCS API).
One-click download, validation, extraction, and installation to user theme directories.
Install directly from GitHub repository links or raw archive URLs.
Direct GSettings application with instant theme toggling and rollback history.
Scan local and system theme directories automatically.

screenshot.caption: Store tab showing GTK and GNOME themes
Installed themes manager with active selection

description.p: Initial release of Motif Theme Manager for GNOME.
